Name: The Soup Mod
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
It's coming up on soup season in my neck of the woods and I thought Stardew seems to be lacking in the soup department. Behold, SOUP!

This mod adds [s]10[/s] [s]15[/s] 16 vanilla-friendly soup recipes to your repertoire. These are known by default so no need to hunt, buy, or befriend. Just enjoy soupy goodness.

[u]THE SOUPS:
[/u]-Potato Soup
-Cheesy Potato Soup
-Tomato Soup
-Cheesy Broccoli Soup
-Vegetable Soup
-Corn Chowder
-Cream of Mushroom
-French Onion
-Seafood Chowder
-Potato Leek Soup
-Potato Carrot Soup
-Reek Fish Soup
-Roasted Cauliflower Soup
-Coconut Shrimp Soup
-Autumn Rice Soup
-Pizza Soup


I may add more in the future but I thought this was good to start with. Just download, drag and drop into your mods folder.

Enjoy!
